acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Golems family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Rune Warrior, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Program-Sequence Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Properly proportioned carved granite body, torso-wide engraved runes, and stone fists shaped like anvils.
Signature mechanic: Three-Line Program: torso runes illuminate from top to bottom for guard, anvil-fist, then ground pin; breaking the currently dark line deletes that future action.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a programmable combo whose torso runes visibly announce three ordered actions.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo; T4 alone gains source-supported floating plates and a molten core; T5 alone gains a gemstone heart and rune-halo.
Inset cistern channels, wet reflective joints, coherent pressure tubes, drainage ports, and mineral-sealed valves create hydraulic motion distinct from native material quality.
counterplay: Attack the lowest still-dark rune between actions to shorten the sequence and expose both anvil fists. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no floating plates, no molten core, no gemstone, and no halo, so pressure loss reveals the joint rune; T4 floating plates expose its molten core brace after quenching; T5 gemstone heart and rune-halo stall when the main valve drains.
identityInvariants: Blocky heavy humanoid construction, oversized hands, small or absent head, blank carved face, and visible joint gaps remain legible.
Clay, fieldstone, iron banding, granite, basalt, marble, gold inlay, and gemstone stay distinct construction materials.
Runes and seam light remain bounded animation hardware rather than generic affinity spectacle.
Workmanship and material quality progress from fingerprints and one scratched rune to sculptural relief and a gemstone heart.
telegraph: Three engraved torso rows light one at a time while the matching granite joint rotates.
